name: 多平台帖子
description: 从一个主题写出多平台帖子：先给 3 到 5 个角度，人选一个，再按各平台的官方长度、话题和用词规则写成帖子，检查后导出。示例是虚构的文具社写信会。 / Turn one topic into posts for several platforms: 3 to 5 angles, a person picks one, then posts written to each platform's published length, hashtag and wording rules, a check, and an export. The sample is a fictional stationery-club letter hour.

topic.description: 这条内容在讲什么，例如：南风文具社的周末写信会 / What the posts are about

platforms.description: 要发的平台，逗号分隔。可选 xiaohongshu、weibo、x、douyin、linkedin、wechat-moments / Comma-separated platforms. Allowed: xiaohongshu, weibo, x, douyin, linkedin, wechat-moments

audience.default: 会把这条转给朋友的普通人
audience.description: 写给谁 / Who it is for

tone.description: 语气，例如：口语、安静、专业 / Tone, for example conversational, quiet, professional

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 角度
stages.description: 3 到 5 个不同角度，每个有钩子、受众，以及这个受众为什么会转发。 / 3 to 5 different angles, each with a hook, an audience, and why that audience would pass it on.

stages.name: 挑选
stages.description: 从角度里选一个，把 id 写进 pick.md。示例已经选了 desk。 / Pick one angle and write its id into pick.md. The sample already picks desk.

executor.instructions: 看 angles.json，把要用的角度 id 写进 pick.md。可以改钩子的措辞。示例选的是 desk，示例材料是虚构的。 / Read angles.json and write the angle id you want into pick.md. You may retune the hook. The sample picks desk. The sample material is fictional.

stages.name: 帖子
stages.description: 按选中的角度，为每个平台写标题、正文、话题、画面和可安排的发布时间。 / From the chosen angle, write a title, body, hashtags, image idea and a schedulable time for each platform.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 按 rules.md 检查长度、话题数量和格式、绝对化用语、医疗用语、导流痕迹和占位符。内容问题只写进报告；JSON 格式不对才失败。 / Check length, hashtag count and shape, absolute claims, medical claims, diversion traces and placeholders against rules.md. Content issues stay in the report; only a bad JSON shape fails the stage.

stages.name: 导出
stages.description: 把每个平台收成 posts.md 里的一节。 / Write one section per platform into posts.md.
